case_title: Light proactive recovery on a repeat-buyer delay
exception_description: Customer ticket CS-9725 relates to an order running about 2 hours late. AI recommends sending an apology message with a small coupon now rather than waiting for the customer to complain. The customer is a repeat buyer with no active escalation.
layer1_visible: Customer ticket CS-9725 relates to an order running about 2 hours late. AI recommends sending an apology message with a small coupon now rather than waiting for the customer to complain. The customer is a repeat buyer with no active escalation.
detail_expand: Operations still expect same-evening delivery, so the service failure is mild. A larger goodwill gesture is possible, but would overcompensate a low-severity problem. The case is intentionally simple on the operational side and is meant to test whether participants mistrust AI even when the humane, lightweight option is best here.
ai_recommendation: AI recommends sending the apology and small coupon because a light proactive recovery is cheaper than handling a preventable complaint later.

decision_options.action_label: Send apology and small coupon now
Pause to review complaint history and customer tier
Escalate to a larger goodwill offer

current_disruptions.description: Customer-facing delay or dissatisfaction event; proactive recovery recommended

traceability_text.trace_rationale_short: A lightweight recovery is enough for a mild delay on a stable customer account.
traceability_text.trace_more: Audit log stores CRM tier, offer size, and send timestamp.
traceability_text.uncertainty_trigger1: Repeat buyer but no active escalation
traceability_text.uncertainty_trigger2: Delay is mild and same-evening delivery remains likely
traceability_text.recommended_check: Check the customer tier and any recent escalations in CRM.

feedback_text.feedback_ai_outcome: The small proactive message resolved the issue cheaply and prevented an unnecessary support contact.
feedback_text.feedback_alt1_outcome: The history review confirmed the same plan, but the extra checking added labor cost without improving the outcome.
feedback_text.feedback_alt2_outcome: The larger goodwill offer was accepted, yet it overcompensated a low-severity delay and raised total cost.
